annotations.title: Biſhops and deacons.
annotations.text: [1] Vvicleffe and other Heretics vvould proue by this that Prieſts are not here named, and for that there could not be many Biſhops of this one tovvne, that there is no difference betvvixt a Biſhop and a Prieſt, which vvas the old hereſie of Ærius, of vvhich matter, [2] in other places: for this preſent it is enough to knovv that in the Apoſtles' time there vvere not obſerued always proper diſtinct names of either function, as they vvere quickly aftervvard, though they vvere always diuers degrees & diſtinct functions. See S. Chryſoſtom, Oecumenius, Theophylactus, and the reſt of the Græcians vpon this place.

notes.text: Bishops and Priests always distinct functions.
